liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd73-03-21.sbd.cotsman.5072.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 232 min; rated 3.79/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: Phil sounds great on Box Of Rain; Water damage to the original tape distorts the vocals slightly; The keys on Jack Straw are blowing my mind [7][12][15][17]
- **gd73-03-21.sbd.miller.29263.sbeok.flac**: soundboard; 30 songs; 228 min; rated 3.75/5 by 12 [2]. Said about its sound: Love Jerry harmonizing on Me and Bobby McGee [18]
- **gd1973-03-21.152104.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: audience recording; 30 songs; 203 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1973-03-21.152019.aud.ryan.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 27 songs; 192 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [5]

## Around the show

- Listener hitchhiked from Oneonta to Utica for their first show [9]
- Band does a headfake on WRS Prelude, skipping Let It Grow [14]
- Band told St. Stephen fans they don't do that song anymore [3]
- Band stated they no longer play St. Stephen for fans [5]
- Sounds like an improvement over the previous tape in circulation [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-03-21.sbd.cotsman.5072.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: SBD transferred to CD and SHN by J. Cotsman [1]
- **gd73-03-21.sbd.miller.29263.sbeok.flac**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1973-03-21.152104.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: taped by from the collection of Doug Lamarre; transferred by SIRMick & Matt Vernon; source: Source: Audience Cassette (low gen) - from the collection of Doug Lamarre [3]
- **gd1973-03-21.152019.aud.ryan.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Unknown; tape provided by Kevin Ryan; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Kevin Ryan's Audience source of unknown provenance; low gen Cassette (Maxell UDXL-II) [5]
